decisions.review: handoff framing supported; MU/NU overlap premise requires qualification
decisions.basis: Table 301 says each NU-listed player is effectively removed from MU. However, §13.2.7.2.2(c) tests whether MU arrays are non-empty and Table 301's empty-array-as-absent text does not expressly say whether subtraction that empties a present MU array makes it absent. For an unnamed hand-off with MU=NU, the source leaves a semantic question: treat the effective MU set as absent, or preserve the present whitelist with no eligible player? The prior assertion that this is a confirmed defect/ADR error is withdrawn pending interpretation. The current code only tracks the presence of any viable MU entry, so it cannot itself demonstrate a source violation.
